justification: Nothing moves this week and that's not me being lazy, that's me being disciplined, there's a difference. Titans D stays benched - I called it bad luck in writing two weeks minimum and I'm not the kind of man who takes it back the second it's inconvenient, Chicago plays, Chicago starts. Emmett Johnson stays in because I just paid fourteen real dollars to watch a kid in Kansas City instead of Montgomery's ghost, and for once I'm not talking myself out of my own roster move five days later. Jordan Mason's in the flex because I paid thirty-one dollars so nobody snipes him twice, and benching a guy I overpaid for out of spite against myself would be a new low even for me. Herbert starts over Geno's prettier projection number because a prettier number is exactly the kind of thing designed to get me, I've read that column, I know how it ends. Rachaad White and Matt Gay are Questionable and so, frankly, is everything in my life, but there's nobody healthier behind either of them on this bench so it's not even a decision, it's just what's left in the drawer. And yes, Tucker Kraft is on a bye, I know, everybody knows, there is no other tight end on this entire roster, I checked twice, so he plays anyway and if Kris wants to print that as a scandal she can print it next to a picture of my empty cupboard.
forum_post: Leon. Eight and two, zero moves, real quiet - fine, be quiet, I've got a Titans defense I specifically benched out of spite and a kid from Kansas City I paid real money for, and neither of those sentences is a joke, they're a plan. You want to talk about typos in the standings, go ask Burrow how he feels about a defense that's allergic to losing by less than three touchdowns. I'm not scared. Why would I even say that. Nobody said that.
